_comment: Per-trail settings for tools/build_legs.py. 'mapLine' is the route-line version (from build_map_geojson.py, in trail-data/map-lines/) that the app shows: landmarks are snapped to it and it's cut into the legs file. 'overrides' maps a landmark name (exactly as in trail-data) to {"query": "..."} (a better Nominatim search, e.g. the town's bridge rather than the town), {"interpolate": true, "why": "..."} (place it between its neighbours by table mileage), or {"point": [lat, lon], "why": "..."} (a hand-set position; put it on the path).

Dorney Lake.why: the lake is 2 km long and inland of the path

Kennet Canal / Reading.why: the Kennet mouth is not named in OpenStreetMap

Cholsey.why: the village is 1.5 km from the river

Dorchester.why: the village is 800 m from the river

Water Hay Car Park.why: not in OpenStreetMap by this name

Source of the Thames.why: start of the official GPX line, at the Thames Head stone

Farnham (start, A31 / Farnham station).why: start of the official GPX line

Guildford (River Wey).why: the trail's footbridge over the River Wey (OSM)

Dorking (A24, Box Hill & Westhumble).why: the trail's underpass beneath the A24 by Box Hill & Westhumble (OSM)

Woldingham.why: the village is over 1.5 km from the trail

Oxted (Chalk Pit).why: the chalk pit isn't named in OpenStreetMap

Greenwich Meridian marker.why: the marker isn't named in OpenStreetMap

Medway Bridge.why: middle of the footpath/cycleway on the M2 Medway bridge (OSM way 31139938)

Boughton Lees (Canterbury loop begins).why: where the official Canterbury loop leaves the main route

Dover.why: end of the official GPX line

Knockholt Pound.why: where the trail crosses Chevening Lane, the lane north to Knockholt Pound (owner's choice)

Winchester (King Alfred statue / City Mi.why: start of the official route line

Exton (River Meon).why: where the trail crosses the River Meon by Exton (OSM)

Queen Elizabeth Country Park.query: Queen Elizabeth Country Park Visitor Centre

Exceat / Seven Sisters Country Park.query: Seven Sisters Country Park Visitor Centre

Eastbourne.why: end of the official route line

Helmsley.why: start of the official route line

Lord Stones.why: Lordstones Cafe (OSM), 47 m from the trail

Urra Moor (Round Hill).why: Round Hill summit on Urra Moor (OSM), 85 m from the trail

Blakey Ridge (Lion Inn).why: The Lion Inn (OSM), 120 m from the trail

Robin Hood's Bay.why: end of the route line, at the slipway

Gunnerside Gill (Blakethwaite).why: where the main (high-level) route crosses Gunnerside Beck at the Blakethwaite mines (OSM)

Osmotherley.why: where the trail joins the Cleveland Way, 1.4 km north of the village (owner's choice)
